title: Geometric reducedness detected by a chosen algebraic closure
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-pc-field-extension], let $X$ be a scheme over $k$ [def-weil-scheme-over-base], and fix an algebraic closure $\bar k/k$ [def-weil-algebraic-closure]. Then $X$ is geometrically reduced over $k$ [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible], meaning that $X_L=X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}k}\operatorname{Spec}L$ is reduced for every field extension $L/k$ [def-pc-base-change, def-pc-reduced-scheme], if and only if $X_{\bar k}=X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}k}\operatorname{Spec}\bar k$ is reduced. No finite-type, quasi-compactness, or nonemptiness hypothesis on $X$ is imposed; the empty scheme is included.

source.place: Tag 035X (lemma-geometrically-reduced), equivalence (2) iff (6) in characteristic p > 0; Tag 020I (lemma-perfect-reduced) in characteristic zero, together with descent of reducedness along the faithfully flat field extension k to its algebraic closure.
